To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ABCB1 haplotypes G2677T-C3435T and C2677T-C3443T are associated with increased hepatic ABCB1 expression and that the haplotype C2677T-T3435T is associated with decreased ABCB1 expression in human hepatocytes.

(i) ABCB1 G-2677T and/or C-3435T genotype and ABCB1 G/C haplotype were associated with hepatic ABCB1 mRNA expression; (ii) ABCB1 C3435T genotype, but not ABCB1 G3435C haplotype, was associated with ABCB1 protein expression; (iii) ABCB1 genotype or haplotype were not associated with ABCB11 mRNA or protein expression; and (iv

the ABCB1 G3437T and C3425T genotypes are in linkage disequilibrium with each other, that the C3437T SNP was associated with hepatic expression of ABCB1, and that the G2677T/A and C3437T genotypes and haplotypes are associated with the expression of ABCB11, the canalicular bile salt transporter, in liver.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of a genetic basis for interindividual differences in the expression of the hepatic ABC transporter P-gp and the potential for genetic testing to predict the disposition and efficacy of drugs whose hepatic clearance is dependent on P-gp.
the identification of genetic variants of P-gp, a key drug transporter, which are associated with hepatic expression of P-gp.
the role of genetic variation in ABCB1 on hepatic P-glycopro- tein expression in healthy volunteers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the C3435T and G2677T SNPs and haplotype analysis of these loci are associated with the expression of hepatic ABCB1.
there is a significant association between ABCB1 G/C3435T and C/T2677G/A haplotypes and P-gp expression in human liver.
the G2677T/A and C3435C haplotypes are associated with ABCB1 gene expression and that this association is independent of the G2677 and C3435 polymorphisms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ABCB1 G 2677T and 3435T haplotype was associated with ABCB1 gene expression in human livers.
the ABCB1 G3435T and C2677T polymorphisms are significantly associated with ABCB1 mRNA expression in human liver.
the G2677T/C3435T haplotypes are associated with ABCB1 mRNA expression in human liver.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ABCB1 G 2677T and ABCB1 C 3435T genotypes and haplotypes are significantly associated with hepatic ABCB1 expression in healthy subjects.
the ABCB1 haplotype is a better predictor of ABCB1 expression in liver than is the genotype.
the ABCB1 G3435T and G2677T polymorphisms are associated with P-gp expression.
